exercise.title: Pick each open string
exercise.why: Every chord and tune starts with the pick finding one string, so picking the six open strings in order teaches your hand how far apart they are.

cells.text:
Press Play below to start the metronome and follow the tab: each open string four times, picking down, one note per beat. The tab goes from the low E string to the high e string and back.
Practice until your pick lands on the next string without you looking at it.
